ModMetaData.name: Essencebound v0.16 — RimWorld 1.7
ModMetaData.author: Essencebound Project
ModMetaData.description: Essencebound v0.16: 24 playable powers spanning chain attacks, area blasts, draining strikes, multi-injury healing, gradual regeneration, protective auras, cleansing waves, restraining debuffs, and restorative wards. Includes ranked monsters, astral tears, random essence attributes and rank progression. Requires Harmony for rank combat. Experimental RimWorld 1.7 mod; test saves recommended.
